name: Quiver downloads
author: Quiver
description: Quiver's download queue in the bar: a progress ring with the percentage or speed while a game downloads, distinct marks for paused, failed and stalled downloads, and a panel with what is downloading and what is next, pause and resume, and a way into Quiver's Downloads page. Polls `quiver queue --json --no-start` (every 2 s while downloading, every 15 s otherwise); never starts quiverd.

barWidget.description: Download progress for Quiver's queue; hidden while nothing is queued. Click for the queue, middle-click to open Quiver's Downloads page.

schema.label: Keep the ring in the bar when nothing is queued
Notify when a download finishes or fails
Path to the quiver CLI (blank: quiver on PATH)
